VA adds $17 billion, 3 years to Oracle Heath contract for troubled computer system tested in Spokane - Thu, 20 Aug 2026 PST

WASHINGTON – The Department of Veterans Affairs added nearly $17 billion to its contract with Oracle Health for a troubled computer system that was first launched in Spokane in 2020, according to a federal award notice posted Wednesday.
